tools.description: Read one return authorization: the order and group it belongs to, the reason code, the disposition decided at authorization (KEEP returnless, NEAREST_RETURNS_CENTER or ORIGIN_NODE), the method (DROP_OFF, or PICKUP while that slice is dormant), the state (AUTHORIZED, IN_TRANSIT, RECEIVED, CLOSED_KEEP, CANCELLED, PICKUP_FAILED), the authorized lines with the caller-declared unit prices and owner refs, the linked reverse-label tracking numbers, the expiry (authorizedAt + 30d) and pricesAbsent (true when a price was absent, so KEEP could never be chosen). Read-only; an unknown id fails with not-found.

authorizationId.description: the return authorization id, e.g. ret-0f3a91

tools.name: get_return_authorization

tools.description: List a customer order's return authorizations, newest first, keyset-paged (nextCursor of a page feeds the next call's cursor). Every item is the same shape as get_return_authorization. Read-only; orderId is required.

orderId.description: the order whose return authorizations to list, e.g. ord-51a0c9

cursor.description: optional keyset cursor from the previous page's nextCursor; omitted means the first page

tools.name: list_return_authorizations

resourceTemplates.description: One return authorization: disposition, method, state, lines with prices and owner refs, linked reverse labels, expiry.
resourceTemplates.name: return-authorization

arguments.name: authorizationId
arguments.description: the return authorization id to review, e.g. ret-0f3a91

prompts.description: Standard operating procedure for reviewing one return authorization: read the authorization and its order's history, interpret the disposition and state, and know when to escalate to the human returns operator.
prompts.name: review_return_authorization
